tests_added_or_updated: 77 new focused migration tests across 7 test files (config, transition-identity, shared-input/immutability, derivation/comparison, coordinator/idempotency/no-go, CLI, finalization-transaction integration), plus one new autouse env-isolation fixture in tests/conftest.py
summary: Phase 135O implements Stage 1 (Dual Derivation, Legacy Authority) of the verified 135M/135N migration contract. A new src/pcae/cltr/migration/ package provides: one shared, immutable transition-input package assembled at exactly the two capture points 135M section 8.4 binds (pre-transaction facts; legacy-completion enrichment, matching the point _observe_shadow_cltr already occupies) rather than the phase brief's illustrative four-way Stage A/B/C/D split, which section 8.4 does not require and the current legacy pipeline does not expose as four independently observable points -- a disclosed fidelity decision, documented in enums.InputStage's docstring; a design-B independent transition_id (UUID4, retry-stable via a durable per-(phase_id, entry_point) logical-key registry, never colliding with phase_id, superseding corrections linked via predecessor_transition_id); a dual-derivation coordinator running the existing legacy path (normalized, no re-promotion/re-dispatch) and the existing production CLTR package (schema v1.0.1, all 37 invariants, all 15 representation adapters, reused unchanged) against the same shared input; deterministic comparison across all 18 of 135M section 12's wire result classes with defined precedence; migration-evidence persistence in a dedicated non-authoritative namespace (.pcae/cltr-migration/) with the same containment/atomicity discipline as the existing shadow store; and two strictly read-only CLI surfaces (pcae cltr migration status / reconcile --phase-id). Integrated through the one shared run_finalization_transaction() boundary all four production entry points (phase_complete, task_finish, phase_report_create, notify_send_report) already funnel through, at two new, entry-point-agnostic call sites; no entry-point file itself was modified. Disabled by default (PCAE_CLTR_DUAL_DERIVATION_ENABLED, PCAE_CLTR_MIGRATION_STAGE, PCAE_CLTR_MIGRATION_EPOCH; unsupported/later stage values fail closed); no single boolean grants CLTR authority -- production_authority is legacy in every code path this phase can construct. CLTR derivation is never published into the shadow generation store, so Stage 1 coexists safely with existing shadow mode in any flag combination without producing two competing lifecycle-completion representations. Resolved 135N's predecessor-transition-identity Non-Blocking finding (F-135N-2) by making it a first-class pre-transaction field. Carried forward and individually dispositioned 135L's four and 135J's four inherited Non-Blocking findings; disclosed three new Non-Blocking findings (entry-point-derived rather than scenario-specific recovery classification; unwired adapter_sources inherited from F-135L-2; intended_transition/recovery_classification intentionally excluded from cross-derivation comparison due to genuinely distinct vocabularies). 77 new focused tests pass; 362/362 combined CLTR + migration regression (285 pre-existing unchanged + 77 new); 117/117 affected finalization regression; 4391/4391 Fast Green, unchanged from the pre-phase baseline (verified via --collect-only before and after). No atomic authoritative publication, authority cutover, or legacy-authority demotion/retirement occurred. Recommends 135P - Shared Transition Input and Dual-Derivation Independent Verification.
